periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, angled toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elliptical ovoid with a visual ratio approximately 1.5:1 (height to width) along its primary axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Clear tapering at the lower interior edge of the patches, creating a teardrop effect toward the nasal region.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Flat U-shape profile across the posterior boundary of the shoulder band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick transverse band comprising approximately 40% of the visible upper torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation across the white cranial vertex, roughly 1.5 times the width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly convex and rounded top boundary.
